sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: WCAG：文字對比與可核對的色彩判斷
related.titleEn: WCAG: text contrast and auditable color decisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付flex-budget.csv、凍結前後寬度與不裁字的修正版。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver flex-budget.csv, widths before and after freezing, and a version that does not clip text.
related.difference: 以(較亮+0.05)/(較暗+0.05)計算，再從實際sRGB色碼重做分段線性化驗證。
related.differenceEn: Compute(light+0.05)/(dark+0.05), then independently linearize actual sRGB channel values.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
flex-shrink按縮小係數乘flex base size分配負空間；min-width:auto的內容下限可能阻止理想縮小。
教學基準：400-100*400/600 = 333.333333333 px；對照：400-150*400/600 = 300 px。

對比率使用線性相對亮度，不直接拿8位元RGB相除；一般文字與大字有不同門檻。
教學基準：(0.8+0.05)/(0.15+0.05) = 4.25 ratio；對照：(0.8+0.05)/(0.1+0.05) = 5.66666666667 ratio。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
flex-shrink distributes negative space by shrink factor times flex base size; the automatic content minimum can prevent ideal shrinking.
Teaching baseline: 400-100*400/600 = 333.333333333 px; comparison: 400-150*400/600 = 300 px.

Contrast uses linear relative luminance rather than division of eight-bit RGB values; normal and large text have different thresholds.
Teaching baseline: (0.8+0.05)/(0.15+0.05) = 4.25 ratio; comparison: (0.8+0.05)/(0.1+0.05) = 5.66666666667 ratio.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TypeScript 判別聯集：狀態機與窮盡檢查
related.titleEn: TypeScript discriminated unions: state machines and exhaustiveness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付flex-budget.csv、凍結前後寬度與不裁字的修正版。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver flex-budget.csv, widths before and after freezing, and a version that does not clip text.
related.difference: 把各狀態可用資料畫成表，success才有value、error才有reason；用switch及never檢查。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate allowed data per state: success hasvalue, error hasreason; use aswitch andnever check.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
flex-shrink按縮小係數乘flex base size分配負空間；min-width:auto的內容下限可能阻止理想縮小。
教學基準：400-100*400/600 = 333.333333333 px；對照：400-150*400/600 = 300 px。

判別欄位縮窄聯集，never可協助找出遺漏分支；型別通過不會替外部JSON做執行期驗證。
教學基準：3/4*100 = 75 percent_or_cases；對照：5-3 = 2 percent_or_cases。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
flex-shrink distributes negative space by shrink factor times flex base size; the automatic content minimum can prevent ideal shrinking.
Teaching baseline: 400-100*400/600 = 333.333333333 px; comparison: 400-150*400/600 = 300 px.

A discriminant narrows unions andnever can expose missing branches; successful type checking does not validate external JSON at runtime.
Teaching baseline: 3/4*100 = 75 percent_or_cases; comparison: 5-3 = 2 percent_or_cases.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
